what: TPG is a global alternative asset manager with about $303 billion under management. It invests institutional money in private equity buyouts, growth companies, real estate, credit and impact funds.
customers: Pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, insurers and wealthy individuals investing in its funds.
money: fees on committed and invested capital
a share of profits when funds exit investments well
moat: A thirty-year investment record across several strategies, which is what allows it to raise successor funds of increasing size from the same institutions.
risks: Performance fees depend on selling investments well, which requires open markets
Net margin of about 4% looks low because consolidated funds inflate revenue
Fundraising slows when institutions are over-allocated to private assets
opportunities: Revenue grew about 33% last year and about 33% a year over three years
Analysts see about 27% upside from current levels
Credit and real estate strategies added through acquisition broaden its fundraising base
watch: Fee-related earnings and new fund commitments raised.
